rationale: After reaching $459.80 (a 2.05% MFE), AMD has failed to hold above the $452.00 breakout level and $456.20 resistance, printing five consecutive lower highs and lower closes on 1-minute bars to drop back below its 5-minute 9-EMA ($451.68). Having given back nearly 90% of its open gains as upward momentum stalls, closing now preserves the remaining profit before a full round-trip or stop-out occurs. A flip to short is avoided due to the strong broader market (SPY +0.81%), massive positive catalyst with 4.92x relative volume, and immediate support at session VWAP ($449.13).
